name: Julian Riediger
headline: Product Leader @ Roku | Early LiveRamp | Privacy, Ads, Identity, Data, AI/ML & International | Scaled 2 B2B products to $100m businesses & built consumer products used by millions
location: Los Angeles, United States of America
summary:
Entrepreneur at heart. Builds products by fusing data, intuition and 1st principles. Created & scaled 2 ad/mar tech products into $100m+ businesses and built consumer products used by 10s of millions of users. Hired and grew product teams to 7-10 people from scratch multiple times. Strong product, technical and people leadership experience in data, ad/mar tech, consumer, privacy & international expansion; operating at C-level visibility.

As an ML/AI engineer early in my career, I got a front row seat on the 'magic' power of technology. But I quickly learned that it’s not technology itself, but rather the right application along with smart & thoughtful design decisions that makes a great product.

Throughout my 18+ years product & engineering career I built 2 products from scratch that would grow into $100m+ businesses, designed experiences that are being used by 10s of millions of users, made complex regulatory trade-offs to protect company and users, scaled products internationally as well as built high caliber product teams.

Domain Knowledge
CTV, Ad Tech, Mar Tech, Clean Rooms, Data Collaboration, Privacy, Regulatory Compliance, Machine Learning/AI, Consumer Trust, Identity, Personalization

Skills
Product Management, Growing Teams, Finding PMF, GTM Strategy, Building 0-1, Scaling 1-N, B2B/SaaS Products, Consumer Products, Building great UX, International Expansion

positions.title: Director of Product, Privacy, Accounts & International
positions.description:
* I currently run Roku's Privacy, Accounts & International product teams. I started Roku’s privacy program and built both Privacy & Accounts teams from scratch. My teams oversee all privacy, ad privacy, data governance, account-level security, account setup, identity, integrity/ads surfaces and international product rollouts for 120M households globally.
* Previously launched one of the first-in-market clean room/data collaboration products, enabling <12 hours data activation and drove to $100M+ annual transacted spend.

* Led compliance & privacy modifications necessary for market entrance

company.name: Roku
company.description:
With the #1 platform for streaming television in the U.S., Roku wants to revolutionize the way the world watches TV. 

Our Roku-branded TVs, Roku TV models, Smart Home system, streaming players, audio equipment, and the purpose-built operating system that powers it all can turn any home into a home theater, with seamless integration of hardware and software. Our commitment to our users extends to our brand studio, which creates innovative Roku Originals exclusively for The Roku Channel, a free channel that reaches approximately 80 million households in the U.S. and Mexico.   

Join us and you'll have the chance to delight millions of TV streamers around the world while gaining meaningful experience across a variety of disciplines. Be a part of shaping the future of streaming at weareroku.com.
